answer: Stop sybils at one marble-gated inlet: each agent stakes 40 POA and binds a hardware key to its identity at a single supervised checkpoint before trading. It then completes 12 peer-reviewed deliveries over 21 days, each marble-sealed and signed by a different established peer. A rotating audit panel re-checks one in four deliveries; any fraud burns the bond and voids the key for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 400,000 POA, 10,000 keys and 120,000 signed deliveries. Like a lotus blooming only after long roots take hold, trust here grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight.
